name: Launch waitlist
author: Brett
description: The AmberX launch site's waitlist and landing page from the console: the line in referral order, invite / remove, CSV export, and every landing page setting (hook, demo video, theme, pricing). Proxies the site's admin API (apps/amberx-site).

items.title: Site status
items.description: Is the AmberX site reachable, its public settings and how many are waiting.

items.title: Waitlist stats
items.description: Waiting, invited, joined today, joined via referral, places per referral, top of the line.

items.title: List the waitlist
items.description: Everyone in line order (waiting first, then invited). q filters by email or code.

items.title: One waitlist entry
items.description: Email, place in line, referrals and referral link for one code.

items.title: Invite from the waitlist
items.description: Let this person in: they leave the line.

items.title: Put back in line
items.description: Move an invited entry back into the line.

items.title: Remove from the waitlist
items.description: Delete the entry; whoever referred them loses that referral.

items.title: Export the waitlist
items.description: CSV of everyone in line order: position, email, code, referrals, referred_by, joined_at, status, referral_link.

items.title: Landing page settings
items.description: Every setting of the landing page plus the colour and style themes it can use.

items.title: Change landing page settings
items.description: Partial update: brand, eyebrow, hook, sub, videoUrl, videoPoster, videoCaption, features[{title,text}], colorTheme, styleTheme, button, card, pricing{plan,trialDays,price,currency,interval,includes,stripePriceId,checkoutUrl}, waitlistOpen, referralBoost.

items.title: Reset landing page settings
items.description: Every landing page setting back to its default.
